newsitem.title: USA: Typhoon Tina threatens S.W.Japan, S.Korea - WSC.
newsitem.headline: Typhoon Tina threatens S.W.Japan, S.Korea - WSC.

text.p: Typhoon Tina is strengthening and threatens southwestern Japan and southern Korea, private forecaster Weather Services Corp said on Tuesday.

The typhoon has top winds of 110 mph and is currently south of Japan, moving north-northwest. Tina may strengthen to 120 mph and should pass just west of Okinawa in about 36 hours, resulting in storm surge flooding, wind damage and flooding rain, WSC said.
Tina may then weaken slightly but should still be quite strong as it tracks toward Cheju, reaching the island in about 72 hours.
